description: #259 final acceptance, the TOLERANT door: `check_facts()` degrades an out-of-domain coordinate to 0 (absent) rather than raising, clamping or inventing, and the Rust bridge does the same. Three failure modes are attacked at every reader on both sides — degrade -> clamp, degrade -> pass-through, degrade -> raise — because they are three different wrong answers and only the clamp looks harmless: it moves a finding onto a REAL line the producer never named, which no golden comparing anchors can forgive but a reader might. The four promoted verdict_boundary_* goldens are the controls that make this measurable at all; before the promotion the Rust half of every one of these mutations was unreachable behind a refusal. One mutation attacks the LOWERING rather than the verdict, because a Layer 2 coordinate that disagrees with the reference is invisible at Layer 3 — the AST build degrades it a second time — and needed a control of its own.

control.description: harness-honesty control: no mutation at all, which must report zero failing layers

mutations.description: the reference's tolerant line reader CLAMPS to the domain instead of degrading, so a finding moves to a real line the producer never named
mutations.pattern: return \(v if isinstance\(v, int\) and not isinstance\(v, bool\)\n            and LINE_MIN <= v <= LINE_MAX else 0\)
mutations.replacement:
return (max(LINE_MIN, min(v, LINE_MAX)) if isinstance(v, int)
            and not isinstance(v, bool) else 0)

mutations.description: …or passes the out-of-domain value straight through, which is the behaviour the domain replaced
mutations.pattern: return \(v if isinstance\(v, int\) and not isinstance\(v, bool\)\n            and LINE_MIN <= v <= LINE_MAX else 0\)
mutations.replacement: return (v if isinstance(v, int) and not isinstance(v, bool) else 0)

mutations.description: …or REFUSES the record instead of degrading, dropping the finding entirely — which is what a raise would amount to for an embedder that catches OwnIRError around check_facts
mutations.pattern: return \(v if isinstance\(v, int\) and not isinstance\(v, bool\)\n            and LINE_MIN <= v <= LINE_MAX else 0\)
mutations.replacement:
if not (isinstance(v, int) and not isinstance(v, bool)
            and LINE_MIN <= v <= LINE_MAX):
        return -1
    return v

mutations.description: the degrade lands on 1 instead of 0 — a fabricated coordinate rather than 'unknown'
mutations.pattern: return \(v if isinstance\(v, int\) and not isinstance\(v, bool\)\n            and LINE_MIN <= v <= LINE_MAX else 0\)
mutations.replacement:
return (v if isinstance(v, int) and not isinstance(v, bool)
            and LINE_MIN <= v <= LINE_MAX else 1)

mutations.description: the reference's tolerant column reader loses the domain bound and emits a column the strict door would refuse
mutations.pattern: return \(v if isinstance\(v, int\) and not isinstance\(v, bool\)\n            and COLUMN_MIN <= v <= COLUMN_MAX else None\)
mutations.replacement:
return (v if isinstance(v, int) and not isinstance(v, bool)
            and COLUMN_MIN <= v else None)

mutations.description: the reference's tolerant PROTOCOL door refuses instead of degrading, which drops the whole method's violations for one impossible coordinate
core_line CLAMPS to the domain's top instead of degrading to absent
mutations.replacement:
Ok(n) if n <= LINE_MAX => n,
        _ => LINE_MAX,

mutations.description: …or accepts the whole u32 range again, which is the core's representation deciding the contract — the reading this change exists to refuse
…or degrades to 1, inventing a coordinate instead of admitting it has none
the ONE tolerant line reader loses its domain check (re-anchored: verdict.rs's byte-identical copy is gone)
the ONE tolerant line reader clamps instead of degrading (re-anchored)
the tolerant line reader's upper bound is off by one — a third DISTINCT attack on the one reader, where the two copies used to give two campaigns one mutation each
the Rust tolerant PROTOCOL door refuses instead of degrading

the rendered code-flow shifts every step line by one. The DROP this conversion replaced is an EQUIVALENT mutant now — §4.2 guarantees every flow-step line converts, so a filter_map that drops the unconvertible drops nothing — so the mutation is re-anchored onto the conversion itself, which is observable
the bridge's tolerant COLUMN reader loses the domain bound, so the port emits a column the strict door would refuse — the mirror of M05, and the one the four promoted goldens cannot reach either
